use default

s_of_n_creator(n: int, source: System.Random) -> (int) -> List[int] is
    let sample = LIST[int]()

    let seen mut = 0

    return item is
        seen = seen + 1

        if sample.count < n then
            sample.add(item)
        elif source.next(seen) < n then
            sample[source.next(n)] = item
        fi

        return sample
    si
si

let source = System.Random(20260909)

let counts = (0..10) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

for _ in 0..100000 do
    let s_of_n = s_of_n_creator(3, source)

    for digit in 0..9 do
        let _ = s_of_n(digit)
    od

    for digit in s_of_n(9) do
        counts[digit] = counts[digit] + 1
    od
od

for digit in 0..10 do
    write_line("{digit}: {counts[digit],6}")
od
